changes: Converted malformed explanatory @task/@title comments in eight packages/main source files into plain Task prose comments, preserving context and leaving executable code unchanged.
usage: Run npm run lint:tasks or koala convergence_check from the project/worktree; annotation compliance should now pass instead of reporting the previous 64 malformed annotation errors.
expectedOutcome: The user should see npm run lint:tasks report zero annotation errors, and koala convergence_check should show code annotation compliance passing rather than blocking on 64 malformed comments.
actualTranscript: npm run lint:tasks reports Errors: 0 and PASSED: All task annotations are valid. koala convergence_check reports 代码注释合规 passed with 21 annotations compliant. koala validate --story=B-407e passed with Verification intent coverage: 9/9 covered and npm test e2e green.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for the annotation blocker. During story execution, overall convergence remains false only until B-407e itself reaches DONE.
limitations: none - fully covered, except validation in this worktree requires temporarily symlinking packages/main/node_modules from the main workspace because npm ci cannot fetch private @koala-agent/lab from npmjs.
pitfalls: The validation failure after implementation was environmental: the story worktree lacked packages/main/node_modules, so tsc/npm test could not resolve xstate. The safe workaround was a temporary symlink to the main workspace node_modules, removed after each command.
